description: What applying a schema sync document would do, without changing anything: each list, index and flow it would create, update, adopt, delete or leave alone, field by field, with warnings and errors, and blockedBy if it would be refused. Always call this before apply_schema_sync, and show the user the plan. The document is checked against the sync document schema locally first, at no cost. Needs the sync-schema permission. 1 request.

allowDestructive.description: Allow a prune to delete lists that have items, and guard indexes

allowRebuild.description: Allow changes that rebuild an index in a list that has items (the index is unusable until it's rebuilt)

document.description: The schema sync document: { "$schema": "https://jsonpad.io/schema/sync-v1.json", "scope": "my-app", "lists": { "<pathName>": { name, schema, rules, rulesTests, indexes: { "<pathName>": { pointer, valueType, ... } } } }, "flows": { ... } }. File references (rulesFile and so on) aren't supported: put the contents inline

prune.description: Also delete the lists and indexes this document's scope manages but no longer declares. Needs a scope

name: plan_schema_sync
title: Plan a schema sync
